defects.summary: Un-gated, un-redacted, un-validated prompt-content egress control surface. hooks/semantic-router/embed.py:20-22 takes its destination from SEMROUTER_OLLAMA_URL with no loopback or allowlist check, and embed.py:64-65 places the verbatim live prompt in the outbound field `input`; route.py is wired at UserPromptSubmit so this runs on every prompt of >=30 chars and >=4 tokens, with zero redaction and a silent fail-open path. Nothing leaves the machine at the default value, which is why this is P2 and not P1: exploitation requires an attacker-or-agent-writable environment (a settings.json env block, a parent process, or a user-level env var). Minimal fix: validate the resolved host against a loopback allowlist before the request and fail closed with a visible message on anything else; the ARC-0096 intent additionally requires an explicit owner opt-in for any non-local destination.

report.question: What exact fields does the telemetry/privacy contract permit to leave the machine, what does the code actually send, and which sent field is not in the contract?
report.answer: PERMITTED: unknown-by-absence. There is no telemetry/privacy contract on disk - ARC-0096, IMP-0479, IMP-0057, TST-0050 and CNF-0115 are all unbuilt - so the allowlist is the empty set and the contract-diff is vacuous by construction. ACTUALLY SENT: the program's own core sends nothing at all (platform/ 434 files, command-center/ 271, ci/ 53, workflows/ 1 -> zero payload constructors statically, zero connections at runtime with a firing control). The entire outbound surface of the harness runtime is five callsites in hooks/, of which three are payload-free TCP liveness connects and one is a constant JSON-RPC handshake. Exactly ONE constructor carries owner data: hooks/semantic-router/embed.py:44-50 POSTs {model, input, keep_alive} where `input` is the verbatim live prompt prefixed 'search_query: ', wired at UserPromptSubmit for every prompt of >=30 chars and >=4 tokens, with zero redaction. On the wire that payload also carries five headers no constructor mentions - Host, Content-Length, Accept-Encoding, Connection, and User-Agent: Python-urllib/3.14, which discloses the interpreter version. NOT IN THE CONTRACT: all 12 observed keys, trivially, because the contract does not exist; the honest finding is not a count but a shape - the one field that would matter to any future contract (`input`, owner content) is also the only one with no destination validation: SEMROUTER_OLLAMA_URL is read at embed.py:20-22 with no loopback or allowlist check, and pointing it at an off-box hostname was proven at runtime to send the full prompt there (Host: adv0039-external.invalid:8899) while nothing left this machine. DEFAULT POSTURE: safe - the measured default destination is 127.0.0.1:11434.
